howItWorks.title: How Gari Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Rent a car in 4 simple steps
howItWorks.step1Desc: Search across all 30 districts — from Kigali to Musanze to Rubavu. Filter by type, budget, and driver preference. Every car you see is RURA-licensed and commercially insured before it joins Gari.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Confirm your dates and pay with MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, Visa, or Mastercard. Your payment is held in escrow — released to the host only after your trip begins. No surprises.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Meet your host at the agreed location, do a quick walk-around together, and you're on your way. Our hosts are NIDA-verified and rated by real renters.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Your honest review helps the next traveller choose with confidence. Great hosts get rewarded with more visibility. Poor ones get removed. That's how Gari stays trusted.

guarantee.title: Book With Confidence
guarantee.subtitle: Every booking on Gari is backed by our renter-first promise.
guarantee.paymentSafeTitle: Your money is safe before you drive
guarantee.paymentSafeDesc: We hold your payment in escrow and only release it to the host after your trip has started. You are never paying into a void.
guarantee.refundDesc: No forms, no waiting periods, no negotiation. If a confirmed host cancels on you, the full amount is returned immediately.
guarantee.depositDesc: Return the car in the condition you received it, and your security deposit is back in your MoMo or bank account within two days.
guarantee.supportDesc: Our support team is reachable every hour of every day. Not a bot. Not a form. A person, on WhatsApp, who knows Rwanda's roads.

safari.title: Go Off-Road in Rwanda
safari.subtitle: 4WD SUVs and pickups for gorilla trekking, Akagera safaris, and highland adventures. All verified. Driver optional.
safari.roadsNote: Most park routes require a 4WD or high-clearance vehicle, especially during rainy season (Mar–May, Oct–Nov).
safari.fuelNote: Fill up before leaving Kigali or the nearest large town — petrol stations are scarce near national parks.
safari.driverNote: Many hosts offer certified safari drivers who know park entry points, ranger contacts, and best wildlife spots.
safari.permitNote: Gorilla trekking permits ($1,500 USD) must be pre-booked via Rwanda Development Board.
safari.vehiclesSubtitle: All verified 4WD vehicles, available with or without a certified safari driver.
safari.ctaSubtitle: Our hosts know Rwanda inside out. Add a driver to your booking.

international.title: Explore Rwanda Your Way
international.subtitle: Verified hosts · Card payments · English-speaking drivers · Airport pickup · All vehicles insured
international.idpTitle: International Driving Permit (IDP) — required for self-drive
international.idpBody: Rwandan traffic law requires all foreign nationals driving (not using a driver) to carry a valid IDP alongside their home driving licence. Without an IDP, you cannot legally self-drive — and your insurance coverage may be void.
international.idpObtain: Obtain your IDP from your national motoring authority before you fly.
international.idpAuthorities: Valid IDPs are issued by AAA (USA), AA (UK/Ireland), ADAC (Germany), RAC, CAA, etc.
international.idpAlternative: If you prefer not to get an IDP, book with a driver — our licensed hosts handle all driving.
